rationale: With AIR 1 finished scanning, we are deploying all three drones in this final wave to cover our highest-priority life-safety gaps. D1 will verify trapped survivors at California Bank and Trust and 348 Pine St while checking the fire at 201 California St; D2 will sweep high-occupancy unscanned blocks in SoMa including Rincon Annex; and D3 will verify reports of trapped people at 447 Battery St and 401 Washington St alongside high-occupancy buildings with conflicting damage assessments. No drones are held in reserve as this is our final wave.

missions.purpose: Assess the fire at 201 California St, check 100 Pine Center, and confirm trapped survivors at California Bank and Trust and 348 Pine St.
Survey unscanned high-occupancy buildings at Rincon Annex and the Pacific Gas & Electric block, and verify Hyatt Regency.
Confirm trapped survivors at 447 Battery St and 401 Washington St, and resolve damage disagreements at Embarcadero Center 3 and One Maritime Plaza.
